seoTitle: FilmEditRun × Cambridge AI | Private Production Scope
seoDescription: Tailored video production proposal and scope for Cambridge AI. Multi-camera summit filming, executive storytelling, and same-day social cutdowns.
heroSubtitle: A dedicated multi-camera production and post-production workflow engineered for Cambridge AI's upcoming global summit, flagship keynotes, and product announcements.
section1Description: High-stakes technology announcements require zero distractions on-stage. Our low-footprint cinema camera packages capture every keynote angle, live slide deck, and audience reaction in pristine 4K with redundant broadcast audio.
section1Bullets: Triple 4K cinema cameras covering stage wide, speaker tight, and live audience reaction
Direct audio integration with venue sound desk alongside redundant wireless master recording
Dedicated director and sound engineer on-site throughout your keynote and breakout sessions
Pre-production site reconnaissance at your Cambridge venue to map sightlines and lighting
section1CardBody: We set up an on-site pop-up cinema studio to record high-impact founder interviews, partner testimonials, and attendee reactions between keynote addresses.
section2Heading: Rapid Turnaround for Immediate Global Reach
section2Description: Momentum matters. While the summit is still underway, our editors cut and deliver titled, captioned social cutdowns so your marketing team can publish keynote highlights to LinkedIn and X before the day concludes.
section2Bullets: Same-day 9:16 vertical social cutdowns delivered within hours of the morning keynote
Full-length 16:9 4K presentation masters with calibrated audio and presentation slides
DaVinci Resolve cinema colour grading matching Cambridge AI's exact brand palette
Frame-accurate Frame.io review link for seamless, one-click feedback from your team
section2CardBody: Everything is clearly scoped upfront: transparent day rates, all equipment and travel included, with complete raw rushes and master licensing transferred to Cambridge AI.
bottomCtaHeading: Ready to Lock in Your Production Dates?
bottomCtaBody: We would love to collaborate on Cambridge AI's flagship summit. Schedule a 15-minute production alignment call with Scott to confirm dates and technical requirements.
